mock.title: Feel the speed
mock.hint: Time to first token follows the prompt processing speed; every later token follows the generation speed at the current context fill. Text is split into tokens at the rate measured with each model's real tokenizer. The conversation test assumes earlier turns stay cached, so each turn only processes its new message.

about.title: How the estimate works
about.memory.title: Memory
about.memory.body: Weights (parameters × bits per weight) plus KV cache for the full context. Whole layers go to GPUs first, the rest to system RAM. On Apple Silicon the GPU may use about 75 % of unified memory.
about.decode.title: Decode
about.decode.body: is memory-bandwidth bound: each token reads every active weight and the filled KV cache, plus a fixed per-layer overhead.
about.prefill.title: Prefill
about.prefill.body: is compute bound: about 2 FLOPs per active parameter per prompt token.
about.calibration.title: Calibration
about.calibration.body: Efficiency factors are fitted to public llama.cpp benchmarks.
about.calibration.stats: Median error in generation speed: {cuda} on {cudaN} NVIDIA results, {metal} on {metalN} Apple Silicon results.
about.disclaimer: Estimates for a single request with llama.cpp-style offloading. Larger models, long contexts and CPU offload are extrapolations; treat results as planning guidance, not guarantees.
